content.text: The document contains no MFN obligation running against us — only one in our favour.

input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The only MFN provision in the Agreement runs in our favour: clause 7.6 obliges Vendor to charge Customer fees no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. There is no reciprocal or Customer-side MFN: Sections 7 (Fees) and 4 (Order Forms) impose no obligation on us to extend Vendor our best terms or to match third-party offers, and clause 12.3 expressly records that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." Consistent with the rule's detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is marked compliant and left un-redlined.
